meta_top_description: The Men's Rhythmic Gymnastics Internationalization Project. Men's rhythmic gymnastics was born in Japan and has more than 70 years of history. Because it has developed mainly in Japan, there are still few athletes overseas and it is not yet an Olympic sport. We work to make this captivating sport from Japanese culture a sport of the world, and an Olympic sport.
meta_background_music_description: Learn about music for men's rhythmic gymnastics. Because routines are performed to music, the choice and editing of music matters. Since the rules no longer restrict vocals, a wide variety of genres is now used.
meta_decorating_apparatus_description: Learn about decorating apparatus for men's rhythmic gymnastics. Decorating the clubs, rings, rope and stick with tape makes a routine more colorful and helps a performer stand out.

meta_calendar_description: Schedules and results for men's rhythmic gymnastics in Japan. All Japan, All Japan Junior, regional block qualifiers and prefectural meets, listed by date. Results of past competitions are kept as well.

meta_judge_description: An app for scoring men's rhythmic gymnastics routines. Even beginners can score a routine intuitively and experience what judges do. The rules are detailed and can be hard to follow, but with this app anyone can evaluate a routine easily and correctly.

meta_oshimitsu_description: Oshimitsu! helps you find your favorite men's rhythmic gymnastics athletes and teams. Find the performers you want to cheer for and enjoy the sport even more!

meta_coaching_description: We take on coaching and choreography for men's rhythmic gymnastics: routine composition and video feedback online, and coaching on-site at your gym. Our routines have been performed at the All-Japan and other national championships. Guide prices and how we arrive at them are included.
